_about: Captured from branch commit b4c14de BEFORE protocol v6 (per-target focused evidence) was added. Platform-independent values only: derived-v1 outputs, v3/v4/v5 execution pins and the v4/v5 response schemas. Request bytes are compared with the frozen builder in feedback_prompt_before_focus.py instead, because rendered PNG bytes differ by platform.

A box means the rectangle that encloses.basis: The requirement names no geometry type, so it can be checked against any annotation.

A person polygon must follow that same p.basis: The requirement judges the supplied polygon only.

Annotation labels agree with the visible.basis: The requirement names no geometry type, so it can be checked against any annotation.

Annotations other than boxes must follow.basis: The requirement mentions a geometry type in a negated or excluded phrase (bounding box). Check which geometry it applies to.

Boxes may extend at most 3 pixels beyond.basis: The requirement judges the supplied bounding box only.

Do not draw a box without a polygon..basis: The requirement mentions a geometry type in a negated or excluded phrase (bounding box and polygon). Check which geometry it applies to.

Every person must be annotated with a bo.basis: The requirement allows alternatives (bounding box or polygon); an annotation is eligible when it has any of them supplied.

For a person partly hidden by another ob.basis: The requirement mentions a geometry type in a negated or excluded phrase (bounding box). Check which geometry it applies to.

Polygons are not required for boxes..basis: The requirement mentions a geometry type in a negated or excluded phrase (bounding box). Check which geometry it applies to.

The bounding box includes the visible he.basis: The requirement judges the supplied bounding box only.

The box includes the head and the polygo.basis: The requirement mentions bounding box and polygon without making clear whether they are alternatives or both required. Treated as alternatives until a reviewer decides; consider splitting the rule or setting its applicability.

The mask must cover the whole visible pe.basis: The requirement judges the supplied mask only.

The polygon follows the visible outline.basis: The requirement judges the supplied polygon only.

The polygon must not be outside the imag.basis: The requirement judges the supplied polygon only.

The polygon must stay inside its boundin.basis: The requirement relates the polygon and bounding box to each other; an annotation is eligible only when both were supplied.

Use no masks for people..basis: The requirement mentions a geometry type in a negated or excluded phrase (mask). Check which geometry it applies to.
